summary: Phase 2 modular paywall (backend gating + admin set-plan + frontend UpgradeWall + admin Usuarios plan dropdown) fully validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 27/27 PASS in ~11s. Frontend Playwright e2e: locked user (trial expired in DB) sees [data-testid=upgrade-wall] on /clientes, /tarjeta, /marketing with Spanish 'Tu prueba gratis terminó' + 'Ver planes' CTA. Super-admin can change plan from Usuarios tab — plan-select-{uid} -> plan-option-{uid}-negocio -> toast 'Plan actualizado: Negocio (CRM/IA)' -> row badge/dropdown updates to NEGOCIO (CRM/IA) · MANUAL. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5583 lines. The require_feature() factory + admin set-plan endpoint + comp invites + payments admin are all in one file. Consider extracting to /app/backend/routes/admin_plans.py and /app/backend/dependencies/paywall.py — same recommendation as previous iterations.

POST /api/card on a fresh trial user immediately returns 403 with 'Alcanzaste tu límite de 1 tarjeta(s)' because a default card is auto-created at registration. This is correct behaviour but it means /api/card POST is essentially a duplicate-create on most accounts — the test had to use PUT /api/card/settings instead. Consider documenting this or returning a clearer error code/message that distinguishes 'card limit' (402/409) from 'feature locked' (403) — today both surface as 403 which is confusing for clients.

require_feature() does an extra DB roundtrip per gated request (db.users.find_one) even though get_current_user_id already loaded a user. Consider caching the user dict in a request-scoped dependency to halve the load on hot paths like POST /api/clients and POST /api/quotes.

admin_set_plan resets `is_comp=False` and `comp_expires_at=None` only inside the 'comp' branch path, but the top-level update dict already sets is_comp=False unconditionally. The branch ordering is correct but the redundant assignment in the comp branch is confusing — minor readability nit.

PLAN_TO_FEATURES is duplicated in payments_service.PLAN_FEATURES, the admin Usuarios dropdown (frontend PLAN_OPTIONS), and the tests. Worth exposing a /api/plans/manual endpoint so the frontend and tests pull the canonical list from one source.
Frontend AdminAccounts.js is 970 lines — UsersTab, InvitesTab, and the plan-select Select component would benefit from being split into smaller files.

Elige un plan para seguir usando UniTech.'; (c) admin POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/set-plan with each of presencia|negocio|marketing|bundle|comp|trial|locked returns expected features array; (d) modular enforcement E2E — assigning 'negocio' to a previously-locked user lets POST /api/clients succeed but PUT /api/card/settings + POST /api/social/copy return 403 with 'Necesitas el plan Presencia/Marketing (o el Bundle) para usar esta función.'; assigning 'presencia' lets PUT /api/card/settings succeed but POST /api/clients returns 403 with 'Negocio'; 'marketing' is symmetric. Use PUT /api/card/settings to validate the 'card' module gate cleanly.
